body: Tucked into the rear of the economy cabin on all 16 of United Airlines' Boeing 767-400ER aircraft are four seats unlike any others on the aircraft. Located in rows 52 and 53, seats A and B on the left side of the cabin, they offer 43 inches of seat pitch, a full foot more than the 31 inches standard in United's economy cabin. They also offer nine inches more legroom than Economy Plus and five inches more pitch than Premium Plus, along with additional cushioning, about seven inches of recline, extendable leg rests and footrests, and curtains that can be drawn around the seating area.

The seats are not a passenger perk. They exist so flight attendants can rest during long international flights. United's agreements with its flight attendants formally require two rows of two seats, providing enough room for two flight attendants to rest during scheduled crew breaks. Rather than installing a dedicated bunk compartment like those found on many larger long-haul aircraft, United uses these specially modified seats, which also frees up overhead bin and galley space.

Whether passengers can book the seats depends on the flight. On long-haul services, typically those longer than eight hours, flight attendants must take rest breaks inflight, so United blocks off the seats to serve as the crew rest area and passengers cannot select them even if they are willing to pay for extra legroom. When the 767-400ERs operate shorter domestic services, often transcontinental flights between major hubs, the flight is usually not long enough to require a mandated crew rest period, so United can release the seats for passenger use, listed as Economy Plus. The Points Guy has previously reported that United generally blocks these positions well in advance and may release them about 24 to 48 hours before departure when they are not required for crew rest.

The same arrangement exists on United's Boeing 767-300ERs, where the special seats are in rows 43 and 44, seats 43A, 43B, 44A and 44B. The retrofitted 767-400ER, now the only configuration of the type in United's fleet, carries 231 seats in total: 34 United Polaris business-class seats, 24 Premium Plus seats and 173 Economy and Economy Plus seats, with a 2-3-2 layout in economy. The 767 is United's only widebody aircraft without a dedicated cabin crew rest area. On smaller aircraft, blocked-off seats serve a similar purpose: on the Boeing 757, United frequently blocks off at least one Polaris seat for a pilot's break and a curtained-off row of economy seats for flight attendants, while on the Boeing 737 island hopper service it blocks off two first class recliners and a row of economy seats. American Airlines plans to block off two rows of seats on its Airbus A321XLRs to serve as a curtained rest area with a sleeper pad for its flight attendants.
en.summary: Four seats at the back of United's Boeing 767-400ER economy cabin offer 43 inches of pitch, leg rests and curtains, but they exist as crew-rest seats for flight attendants and passengers can only book them when the crew does not need them.
en.title: Why United's 43-Inch-Pitch Boeing 767 Seats Aren't for Passengers

body: 聯合航空16架波音767-400ER經濟艙後排藏著4個與眾不同的座位：左側第52、53排A、B座，椅距達43吋，比經濟艙標準31吋多出整整1呎，也比豪華經濟艙多9吋、比前方的高級經濟艙多5吋。座位還附有加厚椅墊、約7吋的後傾角度、可伸展腿靠與腳踏，以及可拉上的布簾。
這些座位並不是為旅客準備的舒適座位，而是空服員在長程國際航班上的機上休息座。聯合航空與空服員的協議明定須保留兩排雙人座，讓兩名空服員在排定休息時間內輪休。相較於大型長程客機設置專用臥艙，聯合航空改以改裝座位作為休息區，也因此騰出更多頭頂置物櫃與廚房空間。

座位能否開放選位，取決於航班長度。飛行時間通常超過8小時的長程國際線，空服員必須在機上輪休，座位會保留給機組員休息，旅客即使願意付費加購腿部空間也無法選位；較短的國內線、通常是主要樞紐間的橫貫大陸航線，因不需強制機組休息，聯合航空可能以豪華經濟艙名義釋出。The Points Guy曾報導，這些座位通常會提前鎖定，並在起飛前約24至48小時視機組需求釋出。銀卡會員可在報到時免費選位，至於金卡、白金卡、1K與Global Services會員則可在訂位時免費選位。

同樣的配置也出現在聯合航空的767-300ER上，位置在第43、44排，也就是43A、43B、44A、44B座。改裝後的767-400ER是聯合航空現役唯一的767-400ER構型，全機共231席，包括34席北極星商務艙、24席高級經濟艙、173席經濟艙與豪華經濟艙，經濟艙為2-3-2配置。767是聯合航空唯一沒有專用機組休息區的廣體客機；在757、737等窄體客機上，被保留的座位也發揮相同作用：757上常保留至少1席北極星商務艙供機師休息，另以布簾隔出一排經濟艙座位供空服員使用；737跳島航線則保留2席頭等艙躺椅與一排經濟艙座位。美國航空則計畫在空巴A321XLR上保留兩排座位，鋪上睡墊並拉起布簾，作為空服員的休息區。
zh.summary: 聯合航空波音767-400ER經濟艙後排的4個座位椅距達43吋，附腿靠、腳踏與布簾，但其實是空服員的機上休息座，只有在不需要機組休息的較短航線才會開放旅客選位。
zh.title: 聯合航空767最寬敞的經濟艙座位不是給乘客的，而是機組員休息座
